text:
deploybot: Build pipeline started for release tag release/v1.22.0 -> env: staging -> pipeline: #8243 -> commit: 9a7f3d2

ci-bot: running stages: checkout -> setup -> lint -> unit -> integration -> package -> smoke

deploybot: Heads up: cached deps layer hit from 2026-03-18, using wheels cache.

alex: noted, I pushed a change yesterday that bumped deps in pyproject.toml. cache might be stale.

ci-bot: lint stage failed in job "lint:flake8" -> exit code 1

```
./src/runtime/serve.py:12:1: F401 'json' imported but unused
```

mike: small import leftover from debugging earlier. I can patch and rerun, or we can skip lint for canary? :thinking:

tara: Not skipping lint. If it's a trivial fix, fastpatch and rerun pipeline. How long to patch?

alex: I'll open a quick PR with the import removal and a new commit `9a7f3d2-hotfix-lint` in 5m.

ci-bot: rerun requested by alex -> pipeline #8243.retry.1 queued

ci-bot: rerun kicked off, but warn: package setup step shows mismatch between lockfile and installed deps (poetry lock mismatch).

jamie: That lock mismatch is likely due to the cached wheels. The build image didn't refresh the lock => wheel resolution differs. I recommend clearing wheel cache for the retry.

alex: can we rerun with `CI_CLEAR_WHEEL_CACHE=1`?

tara: Yes, set that env and rerun. Also add a note to the release window: hold canary until pipeline green.

ci-bot: rerun #8243.retry.1 started with CI_CLEAR_WHEEL_CACHE=1

ci-bot: unit tests started (matrix: py39, py310)

mike: unit tests look flaky on macos-latest in integration suite; one timeout in test_streaming_shard. I can quarantine if it's noisy.

tara: don't quarantine yet; let's see results. If integration fails only on macOS agent we can exclude that target for the canary.

ci-bot: integration job failed on macos-latest -> Timeout at 00:05:00 on test_streaming_shard

alex: I can reproduce locally on macos with the debug flag. Looks like a race on socket close. I'll attempt a targeted fix and open PR for the fix, but that will take >1h.

tara: Given time constraints for change window, do we have a fall-back? Two options: 1) Pin canary to run only linux agents and proceed, 2) Hold rollout until fix. Thoughts?

mike: I'd prefer pinning agents for canary (linux-only) to surface regressions for majority of infra and avoid blocking the whole release. We can run macOS nightly regression separately.

alex: agree. I'll update the canary matrix to exclude macos-latest for this release and push commit `9a7f3d2-canary-linux-only` if everyone OK.

tara: OK, do it. Make a note in release notes and in the ticket that macOS integration is flaky and blocked.

ci-bot: pipeline #8243.retry.1 succeeded on linux matrix -> lint, unit, integration (linux), package passed. artifact: build-8243-9a7f3d2.tar.gz

deploybot: Canary rollout held: decision=partial-rollout, reason=macos integration flaky, action=canary->linux-only, artifacts pinned to 9a7f3d2-canary-linux-only

tara: I'll update the release calendar: change window 2026-03-19 02:00-04:00 UTC, canary linux-only. Release notes draft: mention macOS regression and follow-up ticket (#4521).

mike: QA will run linux smoke checks once canary deploys. I will post results in this thread.

alex: created branch and commit `9a7f3d2-canary-linux-only` -> PR merged, tag release/v1.22.0-canary pinned to commit.

ci-bot: deploy job to staging (canary linux) started -> deploying artifact build-8243-9a7f3d2.tar.gz

deploybot: Deploy to staging (canary) finished -> status=SUCCESS -> duration=4m12s -> tag=release/v1.22.0-canary -> commit=9a7f3d2-canary-linux-only

mike: smoke checks on staging (linux) started.

mike: smoke checks PASSED. No regressions detected in core inference paths. :tada:

tara: Good. We'll proceed with limited canary. Ops: schedule macOS regression triage on Monday.

deploybot: NOTE: production rollout is still PENDING. canalization: require macOS fix before widening to all agents.

alex: logging follow-up ticket #4521 with stack traces and repro steps. I'm on it.

tara: thanks all. I'll close the loop after prod decision meeting. :white_check_mark:
